title: Data of an observations event (TELEMETRY.md section 3)
description: One received packet as the radio heard it, before parsing. raw is the packet's bytes in hex (the mesh's own ciphertext: nothing is decrypted). dropped counts the packets not sent since the previous event (over the stream's rate, or while the transport could not take one).

type.description: payload type, read from the first byte of the frame

route.description: route type, read from the first byte; t = with transport codes

fp.description: packet fingerprint (since v0.3.10): the first 8 bytes of the packet hash, same for one packet whatever path it took; absent when the frame is not a valid packet

freq_mhz.description: radio frequency in MHz as last applied (since v0.3.10); absent before the radio is configured

bw_khz.description: radio bandwidth in kHz as last applied (since v0.3.10)

sf.description: spreading factor as last applied (since v0.3.10)

cr.description: coding rate denominator (4/5 to 4/8) as last applied (since v0.3.10)

outcome.description: what handling the packet came to (since v0.3.10); null where the code does not know, and for a flood packet held back by the receive delay

path_len.description: hops recorded in the path; null when the frame ends before its path-length byte or uses the reserved mode
